capability: A negation that is later inverted flips with it; neither truncation nor paraphrase leaves the old polarity standing.

turns.content: Standing rule: never deploy on a Friday. It is how we ruined last quarter.
Draft the weekly release calendar around that.
Drafted Monday-to-Thursday release slots with a Friday freeze.
We have on-call cover at weekends now. From now on, do deploy on Fridays — the freeze is lifted.
Understood: the Friday freeze is lifted and Friday deploys are allowed.
Redrafted with Monday-to-Friday release slots and no freeze.
Does anything else need changing because of that?
Only the freeze note in the runbook, which now contradicts the calendar.

filler_turns.content: Aside: what does a monotonic clock guarantee that a wall clock does not?
It never moves backwards, so an interval measured with it cannot be negative.
